thread:
Priya: Quick sync — commercial asked for a rev-share gating rule for plug-in add-ons before we sign any beta contracts. They want a hard threshold and an automatic downgrade path. Can product + fin + legal weigh in?

Alex: Do we have a concrete number they want to gate on (ARR, monthly usage, embed units)?

Morgan: Sales asked for ARR tiers historically but rev-share makes it trickier. Their note: 'trigger at $X ARR or 1M tokens/mo usage' — ambiguous. I pushed back asking for a single canonical metric.

Sam: From product POV, gating on "billable usage" (monthly token-equivalents) is easiest to evaluate at runtime. ARR ties to contracts which are slower.

Dan: Sales: customers prefer ARR because it maps to contract size and procurement. If we do usage gating, sales needs visibility into how triggers affect renewal conversations.

Lina: Legal: need automated notice windows and opt-out clauses for customers before any downgrade. Also flag export control on revenue reporting if rev-share crosses region boundaries.

Priya: Proposal draft: gate add-on eligibility when trailing-30-day billable usage > 1,000,000 token-equivalents OR committed ARR > $250k. Both metrics ORed. If triggered, add-on remains available for 30 days while AMs get notified; if not remedied, plan downgraded to base (lossy-quantized) variant. Thoughts?

Alex: Implementation note: runtime can evaluate trailing-30 via the usage service, webhook backstop from billing. Downgrade path is doable but we need a safe-fallback model ID list. Also need canary to avoid false positives.

Morgan: Finance: $250k ARR is reasonable for mid-market, but can we do a grace + remediation credit window? Also needs to surface in invoice reconciliation.

Sam: UX question — how does the customer see this? We should send an in-console banner + email. Lina said notice must be explicit and contain escalation contact.

Dan: Sales ask: allow a negotiated carve-out in the contract (i.e., whitelist certain customers) — we need a UI + csv import for whitelists.

Priya: Ok action items: (1) Fin to confirm exact ARR threshold and propose grace period (Morgan) (2) Eng to spec safe-fallback model list + canary checks (Alex) (3) Legal to draft notice text and whitelist clause (Lina) (4) Product to design UI banner + whitelist upload (Sam). Will put in next planning slice if all agree.

Morgan: Finance: proposing grace = 45 days, remediation = manual AM review at day 30, automated downgrade at day 45. Approve $200k ARR to align with comps.

Lina: Legal: 45d notice ok. We'll add a 14d cure period post-notice for disputed metrics. Need to confirm cross-border revenue handling with compliance.

Alex: Eng: will need two new APIs from billing: /usage/rolling and /contract/committed. Also a webhook for notice delivery. Estimated 3 dev-weeks + 1 QA week for canary + fallback.

Sam: Product: will mock banner + whitelist CSV UI. Also want a small analytics page for affected customers.

Dan: Sales: request pilot for 3 enterprise customers with negotiated carve-outs. We'll provide case studies.

Priya: Sounds like rough consensus. I'll update the spec and post PRD. If nobody objects I'll add to the May slice and tag owners.

FinanceBot: New doc created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-542 (owners: Priya, Alex, Morgan, Lina, Sam)

Priya: Thanks everyone — I'll schedule a 30m working session Wed to finalize thresholds. :calendar:
